notablePrerequisites:
Rapacious One does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block Rapacious One.
You control at least one basic Mountain.
description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Rapacious One.
Rapacious One triggers, creating five 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping an Eldrazi Spawn, untapping a basic Mountain you control.
Activate the Mountain by tapping it, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time.
Activate three Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
